title: Lake Joy Campground

services.name: our campground
services.desc: Are you looking for activities to enhance your stay? The communities surrounding Lake Joy Campground most likely will have what you need. Whether you enjoy ATVing, canoeing, hiking, biking, visiting historic sites, touring southwest Wisconsin's beauty by car, taking in a museum or casino gambling, you'll find it here. VISIT WISCONSIN'S FIRST STATE CAPITOLBesides being rich in beauty, this part of Wisconsin is rich in history. In the early 1800's, lead mining was prominent in the communities surrounding Belmont and nearly 80% of the nations lead production came from these mines.
